reasoning: The referendum is scheduled for June 2026. A December 2025 poll showed 48% support, but historically only ~10% of Swiss popular initiatives pass. The government, parliament, major businesses (Roche, UBS, Nestlé), and Economiesuisse all oppose it. Support typically declines as votes approach. The SVP has failed with similar anti-immigration initiatives before. While 48% initial support is notable, the strong institutional opposition and historical pattern of declining support suggest passage is unlikely but not impossible.
